title: `End.cage(ilk)` Reads `pip.read()` Without `has` Flag — Zero/Invalid Price Silently Produces Wrong `tag`
impact: `End.cage(ilk)` uses `PipLike.read()` (which returns only `bytes32`) instead of `peek()` (which returns `(val, has)`). If the feed is unset or returns `0`, `wdiv(spot.par(), 0)` **reverts** (DoS on that ilk's settlement) — or if it returns a stale/manipulated value, `tag[ilk]` is set incorrectly, mispricing all redemptions in `flow`/`skim`/`cash`.
